value.rationale: The support cardinality is a direct sparsity invariant in finite time-frequency representations used in signal recovery and Gabor-frame theory. A universal first excluded size is a precise structural restriction beyond the minimum bound, especially for composite and noncyclic groups not covered by the stronger odd-prime result. The claim avoids unsupported assertions about attainability of \(N+2\).
